svg.text: GROUND UNIT - wiring (GCS side, firmware env: ground / ground_uart)
PC or Android <-> ESP32-C3 SuperMini <-> nRF24L01+PA+LNA | default: native USB-C (COM port), fallback: USB-TTL adapter on GPIO20/21
powers the unit over USB 5 V
use if opening the COM port resets
the C3, or Android lacks CDC
USB-C 5 V -> SuperMini 5V pin -> adapter VCC. Antenna ON before power. GPIO3 (IRQ) is wired but unused by v1.0 firmware. Debug text only on ground_uart / selftest.
